design_direction.name: Technology product photography inspired cinematography
design_direction.principle: APPLE PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY, NOT APPLE PRODUCT COPYING

background.illumination: large soft elliptical field biased toward the object

lighting.key: large diffused softbox from upper front-left
lighting.fill: low cool fill preserving graphite detail
lighting.contrast: high without crushed blacks or clipped highlights
lighting.priority: specular highlights describe form before visual effects

materials.observation_nodes: silver, black chrome and frosted observation points

sequence: 2.70–3.50 object moves into the right-side hero composition

interaction.mobile: first tap partial decomposition, outside tap reassembly

video_observations.sample_method: 12 evenly spaced frames plus opening sequence inspection
video_observations.rhythm: short, legible visual beats; each shot communicates one feature
video_observations.background: large high-key or dark fields with almost no interface noise
video_observations.optical_language: concentric clear rings create depth and guide attention
video_observations.material_reveal: edge and specular highlights reveal form before labels
video_observations.object_entrance: components enter with isolated negative space
video_observations.separation: parts separate cleanly along readable axes, then settle precisely
video_observations.typography_timing: minimal copy appears after the visual idea is established
portfolio_translation: replace product rings with analytical framework rings
replace feature copy with the portfolio identity revealed at the end
keep one continuous Research Core scene instead of copying video cuts
use no Apple footage, logos, products or source photography

performance.rendering: requestAnimationFrame only while animating, visible or interacting
performance.visibility: pause when hero is offscreen or document is hidden
performance.pointer: batched in RAF using refs with cached geometry
performance.textures: procedural materials; no 4K textures or HDRI
